subject.title: [Feature]: Expose AI model used and usage cost when using openrouter/auto

question: Should OpenClaw add a selected-versus-resolved model and provider-cost metadata contract for `openrouter/auto`, and which runtime/session/footer surfaces should expose it?
rationale: The remaining work crosses provider transport, persisted session metadata, agent runtime text, usage templates, and footer wording, so a maintainer must choose the contract before automation can safely implement it.

options.title: Add metadata contract
options.body: Capture provider response model and provider-reported cost once at the OpenRouter/OpenAI-compatible boundary and expose it consistently through agent, session/status, transcript, usage-template, and footer surfaces.

options.title: Limit to response footer
options.body: Only show the routed OpenRouter model in the footer, accepting that agent/session/status surfaces may remain blind to the actual backend model.

options.title: Consolidate under broader observability
options.body: Make the broader resolved-backend-model issue the canonical contract and keep this issue open until it explicitly covers OpenRouter auto footer and cost display semantics.

recommendation.title: Add metadata contract
recommendation.body: Capture provider response model and provider-reported cost once at the OpenRouter/OpenAI-compatible boundary and expose it consistently through agent, session/status, transcript, usage-template, and footer surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history signal for the OpenAI-compatible runtime and OpenRouter provider surfaces that need this product/API decision.
